author: Yffe
content: Build increments 1b (#176 arithmetic) + 1c (#177 casts) together, extending the SHIPPED #170 Lean S_C fragment. Ast.lean += ArithOp (10 ops) + CastTy (u64/u32/usize/nat/int) + Expr.arith/Expr.cast. Denote.lean: shared arithDenote (int arithmetic, NO wrap; bitwise/shift via core Nat ops over Int.toNat) + castDenote (as nat = Int.toNat under >=0 frame). Partiality of Div/Rem/Shl/Shr (zero divisor/shift) = SOURCE precondition (L0), modelled with TOTAL Int ops held CONSISTENT across denote/refDenote so T1 is insensitive to the partial point. RefEncode.lean: encArith/encCast faithful to ref_encode.rs binop_str arithmetic arms + cast_target; refIntVal models encode_binary's whole-binary paren + encode_cast's ({inner}) as {target} paren. Soundness.lean: ref_sound extended; refIntVal_eq_intVal by induction; NEGATIVE lemma cast_paren_drop_breaks_soundness retires the #122/#146 cast-paren class (paren-dropped (n-1) as nat re-parses as n-(1 as nat), differs at n=-1: 0 vs -2). Core Lean only, no Mathlib. lake build green, #print axioms ref_sound -> [propext].
